name: Amelia Sweet
source:
Daring Academy's protagonist's best friend. Amelia Sweet tries to stay by their side to help with any issues or pain they may have, and 10 years later, their friendship is still as strong as ever. Amelia is often shown as a sweet and caring person, but is often reserved as she doesn't wanna show her emotions to other people. She often spends her time alone, and talk to other people other than just her best friend.

[From [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-academy]Itch.io[/url]]
